subject: the games the same
author: Longy AUS
body:
It's the online that makes the difference. I find there is a lot more european players on the PC, and it's harder to find rooms with people with mics, but they are still friendly & cooperative.

Typically there is less than 10 rooms going, but if you start a room it will fill up pretty quickly, so I think alot of people just select quick match rather than searching.

Alot of newcomers to burnout to, I think, rather than being people already on console.

I'm on the PC a few times a week, my ID is "flatspinner"
